outputs.explanation: This panel shows single computed percentage values (illumination overhead) per exposure-time condition, not an average across replicates, so no individual data points are required.
Panel B is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a line plot of photobleaching decay curves with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel E consists of representative (and pseudocolored) micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve, and individual data points (color-coded by cell, n=5) are clearly overlaid.
Panel G is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve, and individual data points (color-coded by cell, n=5) are clearly overlaid.
Panel H is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve, and individual data points (color-coded by cell, n=5) are clearly overlaid.
Panel I is a time-series of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel J is a line plot of averaged photobleaching curves (mean±s.e.m. from three experiments); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
